tools.name: get_currencies
tools.description: List all supported currencies. Returns every supported ISO 4217 currency code with its full English name. Returns: Map of currency code to currency name..

tools.name: get_historical_rates
tools.description: Get exchange rates for a past date. Returns the ECB reference rates that were published on (or nearest before) the given date. Returns: Historical reference rates for the requested date..

tools.name: get_latest_rates
tools.description: Get the latest exchange rates. Returns the most recent ECB reference rates. The base currency defaults to EUR unless "base" is given. Returns: Latest reference rates keyed by currency code..
